exposure: laser ablation for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS)
cohort: The study included 83 women with monochorionic twin pregnancies who underwent laser ablation for twin-to-twin transfusion syndrome (TTTS) at a single tertiary hospital.
finding: Survivors of ablation for TTTS are at risk for brain lesions, with later gestational age at ablation, post-laser TAPS, and birthweight discordancy associated with prenatal lesions, and earlier gestational age at delivery and post-laser TAPS associated with post-natal lesions.
followup_time: Post-natal imaging was performed, but specific follow-up duration after birth is not mentioned.
birth_weight: Birthweight discordancy was studied as a risk factor, but specific birth weights of the cohort are not provided.
gest_age: The mean gestational age at ablation was 21.4-23.0 weeks, and the mean gestational age at delivery was 31.0-32.2 weeks for the cohort.
